articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: How Investors May Respond To Li Auto (LI) Surging Deliveries And New Overseas Market Entries. Li Auto Inc. reported past operating results for December 2025, delivering 44,246 vehicles in the month and 109,194 in the fourth quarter, surpassing 1.50 billion cumulative vehicle deliveries since inception. Alongside these delivery milestones, Li Auto extended its footprint into Egypt, Kazakhstan, and Azerbaijan, signaling an effort to build meaningful international revenue streams beyond China.
